uutiset.t: Wakefield to take on Sydney Roosters in World Club Challenge
uutiset.s: Super League champions Wakefield Trinity will face Sydney Roosters in the World Club Challenge at Headingley on February 19.

uutiset.t: UK Championship snooker draw and results
uutiset.s: The first 'Triple Crown' event of the snooker season, the UK Championship, runs from November 28 to December 6 in York with Ronnie O'Sullivan among the star names.

uutiset.t: Explosive Fury vs Klitschko canvas row revisited
uutiset.s: On this day in 2015 Tyson Fury scaled his Everest. He dethroned Wladimir Klitschko, the dominant heavyweight of that era, to win the unified WBO, IBF and WBA world heavyweight championships.

uutiset.t: Dawson: Rashid is still England's No 1 white-ball spinner
uutiset.s: Liam Dawson insists Adil Rashid remains England's No 1 white-ball spinner - even though he has seemingly taken the Yorkshireman's place as first-choice pick in ODIs.

uutiset.t: What went wrong for Alonso's Chelsea at Forest?
uutiset.s: Xabi Alonso called for his Chelsea side to get back to the fundamentals before kick-off - and then watched on as they were outworked and outclassed on their way to a miserable 3-2 defeat at Nottingham Forest.

uutiset.t: No Rodgers, no problem! Steelers shock Broncos after dramatic week
uutiset.s: It had been a week clouded by Aaron Rodgers and his explosive claims regarding head coach Mike McCarthy, but the Pittsburgh Steelers swatted at the storm to claim a shock 27-5 win over the Super Bowl-contending Denver Broncos on Black Friday.

uutiset.t: Price out in Players Championship Finals first round in night of upsets
uutiset.s: Three of darts' biggest names were subject to shock upsets in the Players Championship Finals as Grand Slam champion Gerwyn Price, World No 2 Gian Van Veen, and No 1 seed Wessel Nijman were all knocked out in the first round at Minehead.
